name: Bike Ahead Composites
summary: Carbon specialist near Würzburg making wheels, cockpits, saddles and one-piece monocoque frames (The Superfast gravel bike, The Frame hardtail); it also produces carbon frames for other brands such as Last and Stoll.
uncertain: Lamination of The Frame hardtail is done by a partner in Portugal with finishing in Veitshöchheim; The Superfast is marketed as made in Germany.

uncertain: Street address only in a dealer directory.

summary: Cycling shop and café in Munich's Dreimühlenviertel (3 Mills Cycling & Coffee GmbH) that sells Factor, Time and Cinelli. Its custom builds set frame size, bar width, stem length and crank length from the rider's measurements and riding style.
uncertain: Street address only in a city guide.

summary: Nuremberg road-bike shop that sells Pinarello, Colnago and Cervélo and can order frame kits from Pinarello, Colnago and Basso. It offers bike fitting and body measurement, including SQlab sit-bone measurement.
uncertain: Postal code not confirmed. Custom builds refers to frame kits built to order.

name: yaadcycles
summary: Small frame workshop in Stuttgart, registered with the Stuttgart chamber of crafts, building one-off steel frames and forks, mostly fillet-brazed, and complete bikes. Documented builds include a road bike for a rider over 2 m, a lugged cyclocross frame, a track frame and a step-through, using Columbus tubing.
uncertain: Founding year not published; no prices on the site.

name: Bluecraft Bikes
summary: One-person frame building business founded in 2014, making CrMo steel frames to the rider's measurements in its own workshop between Stuttgart and Tübingen: hardtails, full-suspension MTB frames, gravel and touring bikes and cargo bikes. Also repairs and modifies existing steel frames.
uncertain: Impressum gives the business address in Waldenbuch and notes the workshop is in Dettenhausen (appointments only). Street address left out: the published address appears to be a private residence.

name: portus cycles
summary: Small steel-frame workshop in southern Baden (a brand of ekone GmbH) that welds, brazes, machines and powder-coats frames in-house. Offers steel gravel bikes (Kander, Oder), compact e-cargo bikes and full custom frames with individual geometry; also builds prototypes and small series for the bike industry since 2015.
uncertain: Company seat per Impressum is ekone GmbH, Reibmattenstr. 3, 79591 Eimeldingen; address used is the workshop address published on the site. Older press places its development lab in Pforzheim.

sources.name: BIKE: MTB frames built in Europe

name: Bendixen Rahmenbau
summary: Freiburg frame builder making one-off steel frames and bikes to customer measurements, TIG-welded or fillet-brazed: MTB, road, cyclocross, commuter and touring frames, including Rohloff and S&S coupler options. Trained in the Wiesmann workshop; also does repairs, prototypes and small series for other brands. Workshop is in the Tout Terrain building in Gundelfingen.
uncertain: Website news last updated December 2020 (stating frame building continues); current activity in 2025/2026 not independently confirmed. Price example may be dated.

name: velotraum
summary: Touring, gravel, city and e-bike maker west of Stuttgart (30 years in 2026). Each bike is built to order: frames are prepared and finished in Weil der Stadt, coated in a chosen colour and assembled by one mechanic; wheels are built in-house. Sizing and ergonomics consultation with Smartfit body scanning; the Speedster Cr.30 is a 30-piece CrMo steel edition.
uncertain: Frames are machined, finished and assembled in Weil der Stadt, but where the frames are welded is not stated on the site. Aluminium for the main models is not confirmed on the site; steel is confirmed for the Speedster Cr. Price 'ab 3.120 EUR' is from the Finder model page.

name: Cheetah Bikes
summary: Small mountain bike maker in the Fils valley, active since 1998, designing its own aluminium hardtail and full-suspension frames (enduro hardtail, all-mountain and touring fullies, Pinion and Rohloff options). Frames are welded by a German contract welder, powder-coated in over 150 RAL colours and finish-machined in-house.
uncertain: Welding is done by a contracted specialist firm, not in-house; its location is described only as Germany.

sources.name: Cheetah: how a Cheetah is made
BIKE: MTB frames built in Europe

name: Bernds
summary: Lake Constance maker of compact and folding bikes, folding tandems and cargo variants, with steel frames handmade in its own workshop. Bikes are built to order for riders from 1.40 m to 2.10 m using different seat and stem post lengths.
uncertain: Founding year not stated on the site; niche (folding/compact) rather than road or MTB.

name: Maferro
summary: One-person workshop in Munich building made-to-measure steel bicycle frames. The site offers an online frame configurator and shows customer projects such as a steel road frame with carbon parts and a commuter/tourer; the builder is registered as a metalworker with the Munich chamber of crafts.
uncertain: Founding year not published; parts of the site are marked as still under construction and the footer shows 2024, so current order intake was not confirmed.

name: Blüthner Fahrradrahmenbau
priceNote: beginnen die Preise für einen Rahmen mit Gabel bei etwa 1800 Euro
summary: Small frame-building workshop in the Nuremberg/Erlangen area making custom steel frames, mostly brazed with or without lugs and largely with hand tools, one bike at a time. Focus on touring bikes and randonneurs, road, trekking, city and hardtail frames, plus frame repairs. Registered with the Mittelfranken chamber of crafts as a frame builder.
uncertain: The contact page says the order book is currently full and new orders are accepted only to a very limited extent; the workshop has no fixed opening hours (appointments only).

name: Rabbit Cycles

geo.note: Geocoded from the published address via OpenStreetMap Nominatim (street level).

summary: Titanium specialist in Upper Bavaria that has built titanium frames and parts for over 30 years, from conventional welded frames to 3D-printed titanium frames and components. Range covers road (disc and rim), gravel/all-road, a 29er MTB/gravel cruiser and commuters, some with Rohloff or Pinion; custom geometries on request. Also makes titanium stems, seatposts and bottle cages.
uncertain: The site says 'Designed in Bayern' but does not state where frames are welded; founding year not given (only 'over 30 years').

name: einhorn bikes
summary: Custom bike maker from the Rosenheim area (company seat Samerberg) that designs made-to-measure road, gravel, Pinion and 29er MTB bikes in steel, stainless steel, titanium, aluminium and carbon. Frames are hand-made to its specifications by partner builders in Germany and Italy; bikes are built up and fitted in its own workshop. Over 300 bikes built since 2009.
uncertain: einhorn does not weld frames itself; frames come from partner builders in Germany and Italy (only the build-up is done in-house). The site mentions both Rosenheim and a Munich workshop; the Impressum address is in Samerberg.

name: Alonukis Frameworks
summary: Small frame-building atelier in Murnau am Staffelsee in the Bavarian Alps making custom steel frames, mainly mountain and gravel/bikepacking bikes, plus matching bags. Shown at Bespoked Dresden (2024, 2026) and Bespoked UK; its ERT endurance race frames use custom geometry per rider.
uncertain: The website has no Impressum or address; location (Murnau am Staffelsee) is taken from The Radavist and the Murnau shop Velo Welt. Whether titanium is also offered was not confirmed.

name: BAM Original
summary: Weekend workshops in Munich (also Ingolstadt and Cologne) in which participants build their own bamboo bicycle frame, with carbon-reinforced joints and aluminium inserts, to geometry set from their measurements beforehand. Road, city and mountain bike frames; on request the frame is completed into a rideable bike. Started at an LMU Munich start-up competition.
uncertain: Bamboo is not in the materials list, so materials is left empty. Workshop prices and current dates are not shown on the site without the booking system; founding year not published.

name: LINY
summary: Small Bayreuth brand making long-life steel bikes with Pinion gearboxes for everyday use and gravel touring, with a 7-year warranty and a take-back programme. Frames are hand-welded in Germany from Italian tubing and powder-coated in Bayreuth in any RAL colour; bikes are also configured individually and serviced in its own workshop.
uncertain: Frames are welded by a partner in Düsseldorf, not in Bavaria; design, coating and assembly are in Bayreuth. Founding year not stated on the site.

sources.name: BIKE: These MTB frames are built in Europe

name: HUHN cycles
summary: Steel specialist in the Fichtelgebirge building mountain bike frames by hand since 2011, known for 3D-printed metal lugs (Moorhuhn, La Fleche) and the Chabo steel full-suspension trail frame (Reynolds 853), which won best MTB at Bespoked Dresden 2024. Also offers design and engineering work for other bike brands (HUHN WORKS).
uncertain: The Chabo was shown as sold out; one media report says Chabo series frames are produced by a partner workshop in Berlin. Custom geometry is not offered explicitly on the site.

name: MAXX Bikes
summary: Rosenheim bike maker building every bike to order since 1993 through an online configurator: MTB, gravel, trekking, fat and cargo bikes and e-bikes, also frame kits. Each frame is powder-coated in the customer's colour in its own Rosenheim plant, wheels are built in-house and bikes are assembled there.
uncertain: The site does not say where frames are welded (likely not in Germany); included as a small-batch build-to-order maker, not a frame builder. Large share of the range is e-bikes. Frame materials not verified.

name: AnthroTech
priceNote: Trike (Nexus 8-Gang, hydraulische Scheibenbremse, 42Z., Schutzbleche, breiter Gepäckträger, Beleuchtung) 3780,- €
summary: Maker of recumbent trikes near Nuremberg since 1993. Metalworking, welding, wheel building and final assembly are done in-house in Eckental, laser cutting and powder coating by firms in the region. Options include tandem, XXL and XS frames, raised seat, Rohloff or enviolo hubs, e-assist and custom colours.
uncertain: Recumbent trikes only; frame materials are not stated on the site.

name: Selemma Cycles
summary: One-off steel frames hand-made in the Allgäu (Oberstdorf). Each frame concept, geometry and tube selection is worked out with the rider for road, MTB, touring, gravel or e-bike use, using thin-walled, individually shaped tubes.
uncertain: The Impressum gives Weststrasse 23 while the contact page gives Weststrasse 23a. The site shows no dates, so activity in 2025/2026 could not be confirmed beyond the site being online.

name: Specialized Stuttgart
summary: Specialized store in Herrenberg-Gültstein, south-west of Stuttgart, run by H-S-M Holczer Radsport-Marketing GmbH. It offers bike fitting with the Retül system, including Retül Vantage 3D motion capture, plus a workshop. The company is listed in the Retül fitter directory.
uncertain: The Retül directory lists the company as H-S-M Holczer Radsport with an older Herrenberg address (Cranachstr. 15); the shop's own Impressum gives Grünewaldstraße 6, Herrenberg-Gültstein. Specialized flagship status not checked in the Specialized store finder (JS-only).

name: Neckar-Bike
summary: Road and gravel shop in Freiberg am Neckar (Heutingsheim), north of Stuttgart. It states it is an authorised Colnago, Bianchi, Storck, Basso and Mavic dealer, sells Lightweight and ENVE wheels, links the Colnago configurator and offers its own component configurator for individual builds.
uncertain: No bike-fitting service found on the site; custom build inferred from the online configurator.

name: Biwakschachtel Bikeladen
summary: Bike branch of the Tübingen outdoor retailer Biwakschachtel, in the old town (Haaggasse 43). It sells Ridley and Eddy Merckx road and gravel bikes alongside Patria touring bikes, and offers bike sizing and bike fitting on a smartFIT measuring station, also for bikes bought elsewhere.
uncertain: Address is the company's registered head office (Marktgasse 17); the bike shop itself is at Haaggasse 43 per the site footer.

name: Radsport Reichel
summary: Family-run bike shop in Biberach, founded in 1978. It sells road and gravel bikes from Pegoretti, Cinelli, Colnago, Daccordi, Eddy Merckx and Ridley, plus Patria touring bikes, and offers position consultations, a measurement on a Patria Velochecker and a guided position ride on the road bike.
uncertain: Fitting uses a Velochecker measurement rather than one of the certified systems; authorised-dealer status for Colnago and Ridley is stated only as brands carried.

name: Fahrradbar
summary: Shop and workshop in Laupheim (district of Biberach), south-west of Ulm. Its online stock includes Cervélo, Specialized (including Tarmac SL9), Santa Cruz, Orbea and Focus bikes, and it offers static and dynamic bike fitting, ergonomics advice and cleat set-up.
uncertain: Fitting system not named on the site; brands taken from current stock listings, dealer authorisation not confirmed in brand locators.

name: Freeride Mountain
summary: Bike and snowboard shop in Schorndorf (Rems valley) with a mountain-bike focus. Its brand list includes Yeti and Pivot alongside Giant, Mondraker and Merida, and it offers body measurement and bike fitting using bikefitting.com software, with fitting packages for existing bikes.

name: extrabike
summary: Bike shop in Stuttgart-Weilimdorf selling Colnago road bikes alongside Rotwild, Mondraker, NS Bikes and Stevens, with a workshop.
uncertain: Colnago authorisation stated only as a brand carried.

name: 2-Cycle Bike Shop

Opening is partly by appointment.
